text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Thanks for everything, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Because of you, I was able to give it my
all out
there! And now...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can't believe it. I'm finally gonna
show
what I'm made of at the place I've
always
dreamed about!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna have to train even more. Gotta
make
sure my prep's perfect, and then
maybe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
If McQueen isn't there, and I'm in the
best shape,
then...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: We hurry back to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There, on the center screen, is a
broadcast of
another race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's coming on strong! Incredible! She's
broken
away from the pack! The other
racers can't catch
up!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And the winner is Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin
takes first
place!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Ehe, um... I'm sure everyone is here to
see the
Mejiros, but I wasn't about to
lose! ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the famous Mejiro
Ryan, I'm the
one who knows her running
the best—we're
roomies after all!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, sooo looking forward to the first round of the Classics! See you at the Satsuki Sho! ...Even if I'm a sidekick.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
We watch the screen as Ines Fujin claims
victory
at a different racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although her tone is light, she's clearly
issuing a
challenge to Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
